entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The German prisoners of war cemetery, also known as the "German soldiers’ cemetery" is a cemetery of the German prisoners of war located in the Yasamal district of Baku. There are 90 graves in the cemetery. Also on the territory of the cemetery, there is a monument in the form of a black cross. Cemetery of German prisoners of war, Baku is a cemetery from Asia. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
